accepted.s: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) was launched on which date?
accepted.x: PMMY was launched on 8 April 2015. MUDRA Ltd was established earlier, on 18 March 2015.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the scheme launch date from the institutional set-up date.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: MUDRA Ltd, which refinances banks, NBFCs and MFIs under PMMY, was established as a subsidiary of which institution?
accepted.x: MUDRA Ltd was set up as a subsidiary of SIDBI on 18 March 2015 and undertakes refinance functions.
accepted.tq: Use the institutional-ownership trap by separating SIDBI from other financial regulators and institutions.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which Union Ministry administers the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana?
o: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Ministry of Finance through the Department of Financial Services
accepted.x: PMMY is run by the Ministry of Finance, specifically through the Department of Financial Services.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘which ministry’ trap by distinguishing the implementing ministry from the target sector.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding the categories of MUDRA loans:

List-I (Category)
a. Shishu
b. Kishore
c. Tarun
d. Tarun Plus

List-II (Loan limit)
i. ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh
ii. Up to ₹50,000
iii. ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh
iv. ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: Shishu covers loans up to ₹50,000; Kishore covers ₹50,001–₹5 lakh; Tarun covers ₹5–₹10 lakh; and Tarun Plus covers ₹10–₹20 lakh.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pairs and eliminate codes that repeat or shift the category limits.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Tarun Plus under PMMY is intended for which borrowers?
o: Borrowers who have successfully repaid Tarun loans
Existing borrowers seeking loans exclusively for agriculture
Only women borrowers in rural areas
accepted.x: Tarun Plus provides loans of ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh to borrowers who have repaid their earlier Tarun loans.
accepted.tq: Test the eligibility condition attached to the highest MUDRA category.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Tarun Plus was introduced under PMMY with effect from:
accepted.x: The Tarun Plus category, covering ₹10 lakh to ₹20 lakh, was introduced from 24 October 2024.
accepted.tq: Use the date-based distinction between the original PMMY launch and a later category expansion.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly associated with PMMY?
o: Loans restricted exclusively to large corporate enterprises
accepted.x: PMMY targets non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises, not large corporate enterprises. Loans are collateral-free up to ₹20 lakh, supported by CGFMU guarantees, and linked with the MUDRA Card.
accepted.tq: Find the option that reverses the target group of the scheme.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
PMMY primarily provides collateral-free credit to which of the following sectors?

1. Non-corporate micro and small enterprises
2. Non-farm enterprises
3. Manufacturing, trading and services
4. Allied agricultural activities

Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: PMMY covers non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises in manufacturing, trading, services and allied agricultural activities.
accepted.tq: Recognise the broad sectoral coverage rather than treating MUDRA as an agriculture-only scheme.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025–26 figure given for October 2025, PMMY had sanctioned approximately:
accepted.x: By October 2025, PMMY had covered 55.45 crore loans amounting to ₹36.18 lakh crore according to the cited Economic Survey figure.
accepted.tq: Keep the loan count and aggregate amount in their correct positions.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the later CDI figure associated with PMMY?
o: 57 crore-plus loans worth about ₹40 lakh crore, with 66% going to women
40 crore loans worth ₹57 lakh crore, with 66% going to women
55.45 crore loans worth ₹36.18 lakh crore, with 67% going to women
36 crore loans worth ₹57 lakh crore, with 40% going to women
accepted.x: The later CDI figure refers to more than 57 crore loans worth about ₹40 lakh crore, with 66% of loans going to women and nearly half to SC, ST and OBC borrowers.
accepted.tq: Compare closely related time-specific figures instead of merging separate statistical snapshots.
accepted.sec: MUDRA - ministry, categories, limits, refinance  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who chaired the Committee on Comprehensive Financial Services for Small Businesses and Low-Income Households, which provided the basis for PMJDY and payments and small finance banks?
accepted.x: The Nachiket Mor Committee was constituted in 2013 and recommended comprehensive financial services, including a bank account for every household.
accepted.tq: Match the committee chairperson with the distinctive subject of the committee.
accepted.sec: Financial inclusion and digital payment committees  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match the following committees with their subjects:

a. C. Rangarajan Committee
b. Ratan Watal Committee
c. Deepak Mohanty Committee
d. Y.H. Malegam Committee

i. Digital payments
 ii. Medium-term path on financial inclusion
 iii. Microfinance sector after the Andhra Pradesh crisis
 iv. Financial inclusion

Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
accepted.x: Rangarajan dealt with financial inclusion; Watal with digital payments; Mohanty with the medium-term path on financial inclusion; and Malegam with the microfinance sector after the AP crisis.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive Malegam–microfinance pair and resolve the remaining matches.
accepted.sec: Financial inclusion and digital payment committees  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the RBI Financial Inclusion Index?
o: It uses 97 indicators, has a 0–100 scale and is published every July.
It uses 100 indicators, has a 0–10 scale and is published every April.
It uses 75 indicators, has a 0–100 scale and is published every July.
It uses 97 indicators, has a 0–1 scale and is published every January.
accepted.x: The FI-Index covers 97 indicators relating to banking, investment, insurance, postal and pension services; its scale is 0–100 and it is published every July.
accepted.tq: Retain the index’s coverage, scale and publication month as a three-part numerical combination.
accepted.sec: Financial inclusion and digital payment committees  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Strategy for Financial Inclusion covering 2019–24 was issued by:
accepted.x: The National Strategy for Financial Inclusion 2019–24 was issued by the Reserve Bank of India.
accepted.tq: Use the issuing-authority trap among institutions working in financial inclusion.
accepted.sec: Financial inclusion and digital payment committees  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which development followed the Andhra Pradesh microfinance crisis and the 2010 Ordinance?
o: Creation of the NBFC-MFI category in 2011 and constitution of the Malegam Committee
Establishment of MUDRA Ltd in 2015 and launch of PMMY
Creation of the Financial Inclusion Index in 2025
accepted.x: The crisis and Ordinance led to the Malegam Committee and subsequently to the NBFC-MFI category in 2011.
accepted.tq: Follow the cause-and-effect sequence from the AP crisis to the regulatory response.
accepted.sec: Microfinance - NBFC-MFI regulation, MFIN, AP Ordinance 2010  [APPSC]

accepted.s: MFIN and Sa-Dhan were recognised by the RBI as Self-Regulatory Organisations for the microfinance sector in:
accepted.x: MFIN and Sa-Dhan were recognised as SROs by the RBI in 2014.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the year of MFIN’s establishment from the later year of SRO recognition.
accepted.sec: Microfinance - NBFC-MFI regulation, MFIN, AP Ordinance 2010  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Under the RBI microfinance framework of March 2022, which combination is correct?

1. Annual household income cap: ₹3 lakh
2. Repayment obligation: not more than 50% of household income
3. Microfinance loans are collateral-free
4. At least 75% of an NBFC-MFI’s assets must be in microfinance loans

Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: The March 2022 framework specifies a ₹3 lakh annual household income cap, a 50% repayment limit, collateral-free lending and a 75% asset requirement for NBFC-MFIs.
accepted.tq: Verify each numerical threshold independently before choosing the all-inclusive code.
accepted.sec: Microfinance - NBFC-MFI regulation, MFIN, AP Ordinance 2010  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The SHG-bank linkage model was pioneered by which organisation during the mid-1980s?
accepted.x: MYRADA pioneered the SHG-bank linkage approach in the mid-1980s.
accepted.tq: Separate the pioneer organisation from later banking and government institutions.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The NABARD pilot project for linking Self-Help Groups with banks was launched in:
accepted.x: NABARD launched the SHG-Bank Linkage pilot in 1992. It became the world’s largest microfinance project, with banks lending to SHGs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the mid-1980s pioneering phase from the 1992 NABARD pilot.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes DAY-NRLM?
o: It is a Ministry of Rural Development programme launched in 2011 for rural livelihoods and SHGs.
It is an RBI programme launched in 1992 for bank recapitalisation.
It is an AP Government programme launched in 1982 for urban women.
It is a Ministry of Finance programme launched in 2015 for urban enterprises.
accepted.x: DAY-NRLM is associated with the Ministry of Rural Development and was launched in 2011 to promote rural livelihoods through SHGs and related institutions.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry, year and rural-or-urban distinction together.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following figures is associated with DAY-NRLM as cited for 2026?

1. More than 90.90 lakh SHGs
2. 10.05 crore rural women households
3. Repayment rate above 98%

Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: DAY-NRLM is associated with more than 90.90 lakh SHGs, 10.05 crore rural women households and a repayment rate exceeding 98%.
accepted.tq: Treat each programme statistic as an independent statement before selecting the combined option.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In Andhra Pradesh, DWCRA, which served as a precursor to the present SHG model, was associated with:
accepted.x: The Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas (DWCRA) programme in Andhra Pradesh dates to 1982–83 and preceded the present SHG model.
accepted.tq: Use the earliest date in the institutional sequence and distinguish it from the NABARD pilot year.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which institution runs the SHG model in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty (SERP) runs the SHG model in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the state-level implementing institution rather than the national financing institution.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the institutional structure reported for the Andhra Pradesh SHG model?
o: 8.50 lakh SHGs, 89.21 lakh women, 27,422 VOs, 660 Mandal Samakhyas and 26 Zilla Samakhyas
90.90 lakh SHGs, 10.05 crore women, 660 VOs and 26 Mandal Samakhyas
8.50 crore SHGs, 89.21 lakh women, 27,422 Mandal Samakhyas and 660 Zilla Samakhyas
89.21 lakh SHGs, 8.50 lakh women, 26 VOs and 27,422 Zilla Samakhyas
accepted.x: The reported SERP structure includes 8.50 lakh SHGs, 89.21 lakh women, 27,422 Village Organisations, 660 Mandal Samakhyas and 26 Zilla Samakhyas.
accepted.tq: Keep the organisational levels and their numerical counts in the correct order.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly associated with the Andhra Pradesh SHG system?
o: Savings of ₹32,190 crore and corpus of ₹14,500 crore
Savings of ₹14,500 crore and corpus of ₹32,190 crore
Savings of ₹16,941.95 crore and corpus of ₹14,500 crore
Savings of ₹14,500 crore and corpus of ₹16,941.95 crore
accepted.x: The AP SERP figures cited are savings of ₹14,500 crore and a corpus of ₹16,941.95 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the savings figure from the larger corpus figure instead of reversing them.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh’s SHG-bank linkage performance:

1. Andhra Pradesh ranks first and accounts for about 36% of the national share.
2. Its recovery rate is 99.66%.
3. Approximately ₹32,190 crore has been disbursed.
4. Stree Nidhi loans can extend up to ₹1 lakh.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements describe the cited performance and lending features of the Andhra Pradesh SHG system and Stree Nidhi.
accepted.tq: Combine ranking, percentage, recovery, disbursement and loan-limit facts without reversing their units.
accepted.sec: SHG-bank linkage - pilot, institutions, NRLM, AP SERP/DWCRA  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which scheme provides life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any cause to eligible persons aged 18–50 years?
accepted.x: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana provides ₹2 lakh life cover for death due to any cause to subscribers aged 18–50 years.
accepted.tq: Separate life insurance from accident insurance and pension among the social-security trio.
accepted.sec: Social security trio - PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under PMSBY, the annual premium and age eligibility are respectively:
accepted.x: PMSBY has an annual premium of ₹20 and is available to persons aged 18–70 years.
accepted.tq: Use the premium-age pair to distinguish PMSBY from PMJJBY and APY.
accepted.sec: Social security trio - PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the benefits under PMSBY?
o: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or full disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability
₹1 lakh for accidental death and ₹2 lakh for partial disability
₹2 lakh for death from any cause and no disability benefit
Monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after the age of 60
accepted.x: PMSBY provides ₹2 lakh for accidental death or full disability and ₹1 lakh for partial disability.
accepted.tq: Distinguish accident-related benefits and the separate amount for partial disability.
accepted.sec: Social security trio - PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Atal Pension Yojana is correctly described by which of the following statements?

1. It replaced Swavalamban.
2. It provides a pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after the age of 60.
3. It is administered under PFRDA.
4. New enrolment of taxpayers has not been permitted from 1 October 2022.

Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: APY replaced Swavalamban, provides a monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 from age 60, is administered by PFRDA, and excludes taxpayers from new enrolment from 1 October 2022.
accepted.tq: Check the scheme’s predecessor, benefit, regulator and eligibility restriction as separate components.
accepted.sec: Social security trio - PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following social-security schemes in chronological order of their launch in 2015:

A. PMJJBY
B. PMSBY
C. APY

Select the correct answer.
accepted.x: PMJJBY, PMSBY and APY were launched together on 9 May 2015; therefore, the schemes have the same launch date and the listed order is the valid sequence among the options.
accepted.tq: Identify the common launch date before attempting to force a false date distinction.
accepted.sec: Social security trio - PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY  [APPSC]

accepted.s: PMJJBY and PMSBY were launched together on:
accepted.x: PMJJBY and PMSBY, along with APY, were launched on 9 May 2015.
accepted.tq: Separate the common launch date from later premium revisions and enrolment dates.
accepted.sec: Social security trio - PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which one of the following correctly matches the three schemes with their age limits?

1. PMJJBY — 18–50 years
2. PMSBY — 18–70 years
3. APY — 18–40 years

Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: The age limits are 18–50 years for PMJJBY, 18–70 years for PMSBY and 18–40 years for APY.
accepted.tq: Compare all three age bands to avoid swapping the insurance and pension eligibility ranges.
accepted.sec: Social security trio - PMJJBY, PMSBY, APY  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the enrolment figures dated 30 July 2025, which scheme had the larger enrolment?
accepted.x: As on 30 July 2025, PMSBY had 52.54 crore enrolments compared with 24.34 crore under PMJJBY.
accepted.tq: Compare the scheme names and enrolment figures without confusing the two insurance products.
